rules.definition: {"severity":"Medium","ruleQuery":"SELECT * FROM DEMO_DB.PUBLIC.STUDENTCOMPLETIONSTATUS WHERE LMSTITLEDESC IS NULL OR LMSTITLEDESC != (CASE WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('ATTEND_EXT','ATTEND_ILT') THEN 'ATTENDED' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('COMPL_WOTEST_EXT','COMPL_WOTEST_ILT','COMPL_WOTEST_OJT','COMPL_WOTEST_ONLINE') THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('DROPPED_EXT','DROPPED_ILT') THEN 'DROPPED' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('EQUIV_DOC','EQUIV_EXT','EQUIV_ILT','EQUIV_OJT','EQUIV_ONLINE') THEN 'EQUIVALENT CREDIT' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('INCOMPLETE_EXT','INCOMPLETE_ILT','INCOMPLETE_OJT') THEN 'INCOMPLETE' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('NOPASS_EXT','NOPASS_ILT','NOPASS_OJT','NOPASS_ONLINE','NOPASS_TEST') THEN 'NOT PASSED' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('NOSHOW_EXT','NOSHOW_ILT') THEN 'NO SHOW' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('PASS_EXT','PASS_ILT','PASS_OJT','PASS_ONLINE','PASS_TEST') THEN 'PASSED WITH TEST' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('TESTOUT_EXT','TESTOUT_ILT','TESTOUT_OJT','TESTOUT_ONLINE','TESTOUT_TEST') THEN 'TEST OUT' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('VA_DOC','VA_EXT','VA_VIDEO') THEN 'VIEWED AND ACKNOWLEDGED' WHEN CMPL_STAT_ID IN ('WAIVED_EXT','WAIVED_ILT','WAIVED_OJT','WAIVED_ONLINE','WAIVED_TEST') THEN 'WAIVED' END)","active":"Yes","threshold":"0","schemaName":"STUDENTCOMPLETIONSTATUS","dataQuery":"select count(*) from STUDENTCOMPLETIONSTATUS","dataQualityDimension":"Validity","ruleTypeLabel":"SQL Query","unit":"Percentage","primaryColumn":"LMSTITLEDESC","recordsCount":"0","columnNames":"","successCriteria":"No bad records found","ruleConditionType":"bad records","ruleType":"SQLQuery","percentage":"0","name":"SQL query","id":"","addedFromWizard":true,"operation":"<","workSchemaId":"0"}
